newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 20.885 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 20.885 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Friday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.82 percent and 17.76 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 20.885 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all the bids.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction dates and maturity dates for both issues overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 12,512 million levs 8,372.7 million levs
Bids approved 12,512 million levs 8,372.7 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.82 pct 17.76 pct @
